wins.label: Strong Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: Sales in the second quarter increased by 8.6%, marking our highest yearly growth since early 2023.

wins.label: Contract Growth Momentum
wins.evidence: Contract customer sales for the quarter increased 11% and now represents 73.2% of our revenues.

wins.label: Improved Customer Site Performance
wins.evidence: Revenue from sites generating $10,000 or more per month increased 11.6% in the quarter.

wins.label: Operational Margin Improvement
wins.evidence: We leveraged our SG&A and put up 21% operating margin for the quarter.

wins.label: E-commerce Growth
wins.evidence: E-business grew 13.5%, and for the first time ever, we broke 30% of sales.

risks.label: Tariff Uncertainty
risks.evidence: Trade policy continues to create some caution, and we have limited visibility over how current trade policy may impact demand over the course of 2025.

risks.label: Inventory Costs
risks.evidence: Supply chains have gotten more expensive, and a part of our response over time will be incremental pricing.

risks.label: Sluggish End Market Demand
risks.evidence: Feedback from the regional leadership continues to reflect sluggish end market demand despite generally favorable outlook.

risks.label: FMI Technology Slowdown
risks.evidence: FMI Technology growth softened a little bit as we looked at this quarter.

risks.label: Customer Mix Dilution
risks.evidence: Customer and product mix dilution has had a slight drag on gross margin.

wins.label: Record Revenue
wins.evidence: Delivering just a very strong quarter and exceeding the quarterly result of over $2 billion in revenue for the first time in our company’s history.

wins.label: Sales Growth
wins.evidence: Sales in the second quarter increased by 8.6%, marking our highest yearly growth since early 2023.

wins.label: Contract Growth
wins.evidence: Contract growth has grown from 4% in '22 to 11.2% last year and that momentum has continued as we move into 2025. Our contract growth has grown to 84 contract signings well ahead of the last 2 quarters.

wins.label: Nonmanufacturing Site Growth
wins.evidence: Revenues increased 30% year-over-year, and the site count has increased over 18%.

risks.label: Tariff Uncertainty
risks.evidence: Trade policy continues to create some caution. There's a finite amount of energy in the room. And sometimes something has got to give.

risks.label: FMI Device Slowdown
risks.evidence: FMI Device growth softened a little bit.

risks.label: Margin Pressure
risks.evidence: Price/cost is becoming challenging in the second half of the year.

risks.label: Inventory Levels
risks.evidence: Inventory was up 14.7%, reflecting sales growth, relatively faster growth to larger customers that tend to carry longer terms and an uptick in quarter end deferred payments from our customers.

risks.label: Customer Fatigue
risks.evidence: There's some fatigue going on. And that fatigue is not just with customers. That fatigue is with our folks. That fatigue is with our suppliers, our folks that work with customs.
